Great place to relax after a busy day of walking around downtown Grand Rapids. Close to food and sights, the apartment is beautiful and has everything you need. Would stay here again 100%!

We had an amazing stay at Brian and Erica’s place!! It was so perfect and such a fun air bnb! The little extra touches were so great!! Coffee, drinks, and snacks! We loved the area great restaurants and bars close by!! Thanks so much!!

Highly recommend staying at Brian & Erica's downtown condo! We could walk to so many great restaurants and felt right at home staying in their home. I stayed at Brian and Erica’s place for a weekend away to write, and loved the uniqueness of the building. I would recommend staying here if you’re coming with another person.

(if you are willing to climb the 145 stairs) the view to downtown GR is worth the climb. "yes, I counted them!!!"

You can't beat this spot. Owners were amazing and accommodating. Very comfortable! Don't miss this great value.
Expect a home full of creativity, inspiration, and a warm aesthetic! The history, location, and hosts make me want to return. Thanks Erica and Brian!
This place is wonderful! The history and the architecture is such a treat. Brian and Erica were wonderful communicators and gracious hosts. You will not be disappointed here!

Brian & Erica were amazing hosts! Their unit is in the perfect Grand Rapids location - within walking distance to anything you might want to do! Brian & Erica were a wealth of knowledge about the area providing great recommendations for things to do in the area. This location is historic, clean, and a must stay on your next Grand Rapids adventure!
Awesome location! Hosts were truly amazing!! Highly recommend this place!
Such a fun place. Eclectic and adorable taste in decor. They also had great recommendations that were all lovely experiences. Great location too!
Superb experience in every way. Extraordinary and warm hospitality. Unexpected treats. Amazing hosts. Highly recommended. Will definitely return.

If you’re looking for a place with a beautiful aesthetic, this place is for you! The loft has so much character and is rich with history and unique architecture. Not to mention, Erica was a great host. She was even able to accommodate an early check in time. Little touches such as the beverage fridge and chocolates on the nightstands added a nice charm. Location is perfect, as it is only a 5 minute drive to the downtown area. Definitely will be staying at Brian and Erica’s on future visits to GR!
definitely look forward to future bookings!!! Loved everything about the place from the location to attention to every little detail! Brian and Erica are the best!!!

Be prepared to stay with THE best hosts ever. Your stay will be in an architecturally inspiring building which is located within 10 minutes walk to multiple excellent dining options as well as the Gerald Ford Museum. I don't think I can do their place justice in this review. It's that outstanding. If you value staying in places of historic interest that have been renovated in clever ways, you have definitely found the place to stay in Grand Rapids.
Great place to visit. very close to downtown and lots of places to eat. comfortable spaces.
Wonderful hosts. The condo was a great place in a great location.

This unique rental was such a great place to stay! The location can't be beat - walking distance from some of the finest restaurants and breweries on popular Bridge Street in Grand Rapids. The unit itself is very clean, well appointed, lovingly & interestingly decorated, comfortable, quiet. The building is a converted historic high school. Apparently it has a pool and gym but I did not take advantage of those amenities. In all, this place has everything you need for a nice stay. The hosts are very accommodating and wonderful communicators (although they were out of town during my stay so I didn't see them). Would definitely recommend staying and would definitely go back.
Great hosts. They go the extra mile to make sure you have a pleasant stay.
Great hosts!!! Super place! Would definitely stay here again!!!

If you are traveling to Grand Rapids, try your best to stay in Erica and Brian’s condo — it was incredible! You’ll be in a gorgeous three story condo with stunning floor-to-ceiling windows and warm, arty decorations. Their condo is in the building of an old high school, and there are some awesome features (like the original wooden gym floors) still in place. The condo is a work of art and slice of history, we felt so lucky to stay there.

Above all, Erica and Brian are incredibly warm, welcoming, and friendly. While we did not get the chance to meet Brian, we had the pleasure of meeting Erica, who is just fantastic. Everything you could ever ask for in a host—kind, friendly, great recommendations, and very responsive. She also clearly cares for, and is involved with, the Grand Rapids community. Finally, a note for LGBTQ+ travelers: I felt super safe and welcome here! I reached out to Erica and Brian beforehand, and they were super supportive and made it clear they are very welcoming of LGBTQ+ guests. Grand Rapids itself seems quite queer-friendly, too—I’ve never seen so many Pride flags in one city!
Thank you, Erica and Brian, for a truly amazing AirBnB stay, you are AirBnB at its best.

This is the place to stay if you are planning a trip to GR. It was a 10/10. So close to everything and in a safe location. Brian & Erica made sure everything was ready and gave lots a great tips of what to do and where the best places are.
I can’t wait to plan my next trip! Thank you 😊

What an interesting re-design of an old school building! It was fun to imagine the space being used by high school students decades ago and we particularly enjoyed the original metal beams throughout the apartment as well as the three story arched window. Brian and Erica have decorated with an array of eclectic art objects and wall pieces. We walked to many local restaurants and attractions. We recommend them as welcoming hosts!
Unique! Clean! Close to fun restaurants! Erica and Brian are amazing hosts! They were easy to contact and had a lovely home with many amenities provided for you. Can’t wait to visit again!

Fantastic stay! Brian and Erica’s place is great. Perfect location. Plenty of restaurants, breweries, coffee shops, etc within walking distance. Clean, comfortable, feeling of being at home yet all the fun of a get-away! Very unique place with lots of style. We look forward to a return trip.

This was a wonderful weekend trip! Erica and Brian went above and beyond to help us have a nice weekend. The location is within walking distance to several breweries and driving distance to many more. The building had a lot of history that Erica kindly shared with us and was such a fun experience. I definitely recommend downloading the Brewsader app if you enjoy beer or cider! Definitely would stay again!!!
1000% recommended. You will fall in love with this Airbnb!!

I am no usually a person that writes reviews, but this place definitely deserves it. This is an AWESOME place to stay. The home is full of character, the architecture of the building is beautiful and full of history. The home is super clean and beautiful. The place is at walking distance to a bunch of fun places to hangout and eat. 10/10.

The definition of a five-star listing!!! Brian and Erica’s home was even better than described. The bed was wonderfully comfy and we had everything and more that we could have needed during our stay. Part of our visit was a celebration of my friend’s birthday and Brian and Erica SO kindly had a bottle of local wine waiting for us when we arrived! The rooftop pool is incredible and we had the amazing fortune of meeting some other residents while we were up there who invited us to a fun get together on their attached rooftop deck! All in all we couldn’t have had a more wonderful experience with Brian and Erica’s airbnb. The only “negative” was that they were out of town the majority of the time we were there so we didn’t get to know them as well as we would have liked!! It just means we will have to come back again another time!!!
Erica was top notch and so was her place. It was the best Air B&B experience we have ever had.
Erica was such a wonderful host! The place is so beautiful and really in such a good location to just about anything. 11/10 recommend and will be back again
Friendly people, fun place downtown!
You can expect a nice, clean, and vibrant loft to stay in. Clear communication and kindness for lovely hosts.
A wonderful and fun place to stay! Erica and Brian’s place is so cool and walking distance to great restaurants! I would definitely stay here again!

Excellent location, many places within walking distance. Space is perfect for 2 people. Hosts are more than accommodating. We did not want for anything during our stay as Erica and Brian have thought of it all! Definitely recommend!

Would highly recommend this space for a weekend getaway to Grand Rapids! The locations in phenomenal, only a three minute walk from so many great restaurants. Erica made us feel so welcomed and although it’s a shared space, we had so much privacy. The only bummer was that we were really looking forward to using the rooftop hot tub, however it was out of order when we were there. Will definitely be back!

This place is so cool! My boyfriend and I found it to be the perfect spot for our Valentine’s Day trip to Grand Rapids. The view was great and it was so cozy watching the snowfall out the huge sunny windows. The location was perfect and we especially appreciated how thoughtful our hosts were in making this such a special trip for us. Highly recommend!!
Highly recommend staying here if you get the chance! Amazing views, value and more! You won’t want to leave :)
Great communication, great recommendations! Would definitely stay again!

I just want to personally thank Brian and Erica for welcoming us into their home! This is the most outstanding AirBnB that I’ve ever stayed in. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a place to stay and will definitely be back! They provided so many amenities that were so thoughtful and helpful. Thank you Brian and Erica!
Fantastic location, fantastic space, fantastic hosts, just fantastic!!
Recommended location for a grand rapids stay.

Brian & Erica were great hosts, it was easy to see why their rental is so highly rated. Great location just a few blocks away from the Bridge St district with a number of good restaurant and bar options. Easy to get anywhere else in the city be it by car, bike or scooter. The space was clean and very-well maintained, and our hosts were so friendly and quick to offer recommendations. Would recommend!
Although our stay was brief, they offered excellent hospitality. Their home is gorgeous. They have an exceptional business model. Next time we will stay longer!
This was our 1st Airbnb experience and Erica was awesome to help us. They had everything ready for us when we arrived. She was always available via phone or text when/if we needed anything.
This was the last leg of our 10th Anniversary trip and couldn't have met nicer people.

The loft was in a great location, walking distance to many great restaurants. It was clean and artfully decorated. The hosts were super hospitable and added special touches for our anniversary celebration. Would definitely recommend to others!
Nice weekend getaway space. Thank you!

Erica and Brian are the most wonderful and amazing hosts. They make your stay so special and it really feels like a home away from home. Their place is beautiful, clean, amazingly decorated and just a wonderful little gem. Highly recommend staying here. We’ve been twice now and would never stay anywhere else when visiting Grand Rapids.

Brian and Erica’s Place is super cute and clean! They are incredibly welcoming and helpful hosts. They provided me with excellent recommendations and were nothing but friendly people who love their city. Highly recommend!!

Brian and Erica's place, a condo in a renovated school building, is unique and welcoming, with fascinating history and wonderful amenities (including access to a rooftop pool and hot tub!). While there, you'll be just blocks away from countless delicious restaurants and breweries, and treated with warmth and amazing hospitality. If you're looking for a one-of-a-kind way to see Grand Rapids, this is it.
Brian and Erica are great hosts, and work to ensure that their guests feel welcome. Their place is located in a great area of Grand Rapids, and the room was very comfortable.

Erica and Brian are the best! Their condo is literally one of a kind. Everything was as advertised. Location is close to everything. West side is best side! I will definitely stay here again in the future.
Enjoyed our one night here! Super friendly host and super clean private room.
Awesome space and even better hosts. Couldn’t think of a better place to stay in GR! Loved our visit.

Such a cool place to visit! Love all the history about the old school. In the perfect location, walking distance to most things we had planned! We had a ton of fun on our short stay & would definitely stay here again!
The most beautiful airbnb we have ever stayed in. very private and home like. would highly recommend.
Best hosts & space EVER!

Hosts, location, mission - so blessed to have found this space. We came here for a Broadway show and since we’ve fallen in love with the exquisiteness of the space, the exemplary lives of Brian & Erica and how uniquely convenient their location is.
Would not stay anywhere else in GR for business or leisure.
Great location! You can easily walk from here to downtown. The condo had a lot of personality. The hosts were very friendly and welcoming.
Great host, super adorable and clean place!! The roof top hot tub was awesome at night with the beautiful city view. The bed and bedding were so comfortable!! Short walk to local bars and breweries!!

We stayed at Erica and Brian’s overnight while coming into town for a show. It was excellent! The space was very private and eclectic, and the building itself is very cool. It’s in a great location. There were also lots of extra touches that we appreciated, like snacks and drinks! Would definitely recommend.
Best Airbnb ever!

Brian and Erica are truly wonderful hosts. They are warm and welcoming and their home is charming. The building itself is an architectural gem. Great location as it was close to music, beer, and food. We loved everything about our stay!
This is a great location and space!
Amazing amazing amazing. Local awesome community 4 blocks of awesome. If you like mom and pop stuff with a youth twist. Stay here.
Erica and Brian not only are the best hosts we’ve experienced upon staying in different spaces but they have the best location in Grand Rapids.

Their place is sensibly decorated with exquisite tast evoking culture, family and nature to start the stay on a great note. Their suite has several amenities (TV, coffee, snacks, hydration) ideal to relax, work or play. The rooftop boasts a great view of the skyline and the hot tub an ideal spot to enjoy a snowy Winter day or a sunny summer.
Conveniently located to both downtown and west end highlights, Brian and Erica have an extensive in-depth knowledge of the best spots to visit that only locals would master.
Definitely recommend their space and their hosting. It gets better with each stay!!
Fantastic space in renovated HS gymnasium. Lots of character, rooftop hot tub was the main draw for me. Hosts were A+++! Would love to stay again.

What a great spot! Excellent location and very comfortable setup. I had an easy walk to downtown, the Riverwalk, and several notable restaurants & breweries, and Erica was a warm, generous presence from the very start!

Brian & Erica's place was great - they were actually out of town during my trip but Dexter who helped out in their absence was thorough, polite, and fast to respond. The space was cute, inviting, clean, and spacious. The bed was also very comfortable.
PS - they also had ample snacks which my friend and I greatly appreciated after long days!

Brian and Erica were very nice and told us of all the places to visit. The Airbnb was in a great location and decorated perfectly. I’d recommend staying here to everyone. We loved it. New Holland Brewing and many other great places was just a few walking minutes away.

Brian and Erica were friendly and gave us so much info on the area and the property itself. The location is perfect with so many places within an 8-10 minute walk. The Airbnb was very well kept and fantastically decorated. We will stay next time we visit if it’s available.
Great location to experience downtown Grand Rapids...Very unique home with great amenities.

This place is such a gem! Grand Rapids is such a cool city, but Brian and Erica’s place is even cooler! Wait until you see the rooftop pool/hot tub/cabana. Wow! We were so impressed. Cannot say a bad thing about this one. As I told the hosts...if I could give this 10 stars, I would!

Very clean place in a walkable neighborhood. You must be able to do steps , as there many, since it's in an old school! Great use of an old high school! Great host's, that responded quickly, anytime we had a question!

Condo was amazing. How they redid an old school into what it is now is just gorgeous. Erica and Brian’s place was perfect location to bars and restaurants just down the street and the hospitality was perfect!
Brian and Erica were lovely hosts who really enjoyed having guests. They have a very unique, GREAT place. Very clean. Very cozy. Will definitely go back in the future. 😘
Stayed a few nights
Awesome location and awesome hosts. 10/10 would recommend!
Stayed one night
The best space in the Grand Rapids area with amazing hosts.

Erica & Brian’s place has exquisite appointments, a terrific rooftop pool area to relax after work and very convenient gated parking (walk or Uber everywhere from here).
Their communication is great and their knowledge of interesting unique places in the area a definite gem amongst hosts.
Highly recommend them and looking forward to staying again.
This place is so fun! Love the eclectic decor and special touches! Unfortunately we didn’t get to meet Erica,
but Brian was a wonderful host.
Super comfy bed, clean and what a great location to walk to restaurants and bars.
It's a nice space, but can be a bit tricky inside the building to find where you want to be.

There is a game room with a pool table and a cool old school shuffleboard table up by the pool. The rooftop pool is nice, as is their private space to enjoy the roof deck. When we were there the hot tub was not usable, which was a bummer, but we still sat in the deck space just hanging out.
The hosts were great to work with but keep in mind that the room is windowless.

This place is AMAZING! Brian and Erica were very hospitable and had lots of nice touches. Coffee and water and even a couple of sodas and Beer City beers. The building is SO COOL and the history maintained in the old school was really neat to check out. The rooftop pool was great on a hot summer day with beautiful views of downtown. Location was perfect - very close to New Holland Brewery and lots of great restaurants and bars. I highly recommend this place to everyone - you will not be disappointed. Just wish we could give it more stars! We will definitely stay there again if we are in the area.
Beautiful place, convenient to downtown Grand Rapids and convention center. Great hosts!

Brian and Erica were such wonderful hosts. They were so welcoming and inviting, making us feel so at home. They offered wonderful extra amenities like a refrigerator full of refreshments, a basket full of snack and Keurig coffee with many choices of Keurig pods. The third floor we stayed was so quiet and private. Thank you to Brian and Erica. We will be sure to stay here again next time we spend time in Grand Rapids.

This was our first time staying at an Air B&B and we really did not know what to expect. I can say that we were blown away with our experience. Brian and Erica we not only wonderful hosts but their place was absolutely amazing. We had the entire third floor all to our selves. The location was exactly were we wanted to be and we were able to take advantage of the pool and hot tub. We will definitely stay here again the next time we are in

I had such a great time staying at this place. Bed was really comfy, everything really clean, nice touches when it came to snacks and personal fridge stocked with water. Erica even got me a small growler full of hard cider for an extra “oomph” of hospitality, especially since it was Cider Week. The fans in the bedroom were helpful since I’m always hot, the view on the roof was awesome and the hot tub was perfect. I highly suggest anyone stay here if you’re in the GR area. Especially if you’re looking for a host who wants to show you around and have a good conversation with. (She’s also great at giving privacy if that’s how you prefer your trip). I hope to come back and visit sometime in the future.
Beautiful building to stay in and lovely hosts .
However the accommodation is shared and this needs to be made clearer in the description .
Erica & Brian’s apartment is amazing. Close to everything; has everything one could ever want; and they are fundamentally hospitable people. I hope I have the chance to stay with them again soon!
Gorgeous/unique space, cozy bed, great amenities. Highly recommend.

First and foremost the location of the union square building is perfect for those who want to stay near to the city. The building itself is also the most unique set up, it used to be an old school that still has many of the original features just modified for living space. Erica was seriously the nicest person ever and super hospitable, her living space was so unique and you could tell every little decoration was personal. She also had lots of local suggestions for us to try out and we enjoyed all of those we tried out.
We definitely plan on going back to GR in the summer and we hope to stay here again.
Oh btw the bed is super comfortable and they provide you with an Alexa which is also pretty dope.
You get the entire 3rd floor. Loft area with cable tv, mini fridge and coffee maker. Nice bathroom with a shower.

Brian and Erica's cozy little space is part of a larger apartment in an old public school on Grand Rapids's east side that has been splendidly rehabbed. There is a big comfortable bed and a small sitting room that overlooks floor to ceiling arched windows, with access to a pool and hot tub on the roof. The locale is close to downtown and local brewpubs. Communication and checkin were easy and our hosts were very accommodating in showing us around. Erica even snapped a lovely photo of us on the roof with the G.R. skyline in the background. Be nice to her and maybe she'll do the same for you!
Great host and space! We had a fabulous time and would highly recommend!
Awesome space! Close to everything downtown and lots of character.
Great location for walking to breweries and downtown. Hot tub on roof was great.

Just a short drive to downtown. Everything was clean and the space was very stylish. Lot's of thoughtful touches like snacks, water and coffee available. Checking in and out was quick and easy! We loved everything about their place!
The loft space was comfortable and stylish. Great hospitality and communication with hosts!
Really cool building! Might be a bit confusing to get around at first but I was personally shown the ropes and got the hang of it. The roof view is amazing!
Great host and a wonderful space!
Great place to stay. Very quiet and relaxing and very gracious and attentive hosts. Highly recommended!

Brian and Erica are welcoming, genuine people who have as much excitement for sharing their beautiful home and its history as a teen passing their driver's test on the third try. They are happy and kind and their place reflects the warmth Erica greets you with. The space is comfy, quirky, inviting, and calming (yet you will find something new and interesting about the condo and building at every turn).
One of the neatest places I've been to and the hosts are top notch... cannot recommend a better place in Grand Rapids.
loved the eclectic cozy atmosphere and welcoming hospitality. Amazing displays of art! you will NOT be disappointed. loved our stay!

Erica and Brian are great hosts. Their BnB is clean, well decorated, and has all the accommodations you need for a great stay in Grand Rapids! They are very hospitable and have great advice about the area. We have stayed with them multiple times and this BnB is consistently great!

Brian and Erica were FANTASTIC hosts! My friend and I were blown away 😊. They both were extremely helpful when it came to teaching us country girls how to get our way around the city 😁. Thank you again, Brian and Erica for making our first Airbnb experience better than we thought it could be ❤. I would/will book again!
Unique space and warm hospitality!

Awesome place, awesome people, great location!! Brian and Erica were very accommodating as I arrived much later than intended and had great local recommendations. Would stay here again in a heartbeat!!
Brian and Erica were the perfect hosts! Their place is amazing and they gave us great suggestions on what to do in the area. Thanks for having us!!
Wonderful hosts! Could not be more helpful!!!
Great location and great place!
Not enough nice things to say!
We love this place! Brian and Erica RULE!!!!!

Brian and Erica’s home was perfect! They were extremely accommodating, and we loved their unique guest room and how close they were to downtown Grand Rapids. We will definitely stay with them again next time we’re in town!
Overall a great place to stay. Close to the many sites and sounds of Grand rapids.
Wonderful people, so kind generous, helpful, loving... Incredibly unique & lovely space, great location!
Erica was great! A beautiful and very private feel to a shared space. The hot tub on the roof at night was amazing. Walking distance to breweries and restaurants.

This location, lost, and hosts were awesome. Both were very friendly and quick to respond for check in and any questions I had. The amenities here were great and they did an awesome job giving me tips on places to check out.
I would absolutely stay here again!
Great find.

Erica welcomed us right away, making us feel comfortable. Only seen Brian briefly, but was very nice as well. Absolutely lived their home and all they had to offer. Overall wonderful people and would definitely be interested in going back .
Beautiful historic building with so many personal little touches- a stay away favorite in GR for certain!!
Great place, and better Hosts. Highly recommend a stay with Erica, and Brian!
Great central location, amazing hospitality, and the rooftop pool and hot tub were great!

A fascinating property in terms of its architecture, interior design, and fun factor. Brian and Erica are super cool hosts. Loved having Alexa music in the bedroom. Great restaurants, breweries, amenities, and recreation in this area of Grand Rapids.

Brian & Erica’s Place is amazing. The pictures don’t do it justice. They communication we fast, the space is just very cool. Brian & Erica just made you feel like family in their house. The area is a great area and I can’t wait to,come back.

We were in Grand Rapids to photograph a wedding and couldn’t have been luckier to stay with Brian & Erica. They went above and beyond —accommodated an early checkin, had excellent snacks, let me leave my camera gear in the living room so I didn’t have to carry it up to the 3rd floor, and Erica even gave me a ride to downtown with a great tour along the way! Last but not least, it was such a treat to enjoy the rooftop hot tub! One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had and best hosts I’ve ever met!

My Boyfriend and I had a great time. This place was every bit as cool as I thought it would be! Erica and Brian were absolutely wonderful. Very friendly and helpful but also great at giving us our space.

This was my first time in GR and it was an amazing stay!! Would definitely recommend- just wished we would have stayed longer. The condo is so cute and stylish and Brian and Erica are so friendly and great hosts! Amazing roof top pool and hot tub and walking distance to all the local bars and restaurants.

Brian and Erica's cozy townhouse loft is an excellent booking for anyone looking for a place to relax just outside of downtown Grand Rapids. It's only a couple minute walk from top-notch establishments like New Holland Brewing and the Jolly Pumpkin and only a quick cab ride to the heart of GR. Their apartment is a three-story loft that is part of a repurposed gymnasium in an old school building giving the space a very cool personality. The entire complex is clean, quiet and friendly! Don't forget to utilize the rooftop pool, hot tub and patio which is open until 1am! I would certainly book again if I were back in town!

Wow! What a fabulous experience. By far this was our favorite AirBNB experience yet and we would recommend it to anyone. Every detail matters to Brian and Erica and the attention to detail far exceeded our expectations.

What’s most exceptional was the energy and spirit of the hosts. A couple who truly understand the importance of the ‘sharing economy’ yet appreciate the privacy and experience of their guests. We will be back and are looking forward to seeing the impact Brian and Erica make in the community they live. 5+ stars for sure.
Brian and Erica’s place was really neat and the location was pretty close to downtown (close enough to walk, but there is also a bus stop right outside).

We were here for a short stay in Grand Rapids. The hosts were nice and helpful and had good recommendations on restaurants. The condo is super cute and has lots of books and a nice loft area. There is a pool upstairs and it is in a great location near local restaurants and bars.

Erica was seriously an angel. One of the kindest and most genuinely likable people I’ve ever met. She’s in the perfect line of work. We unfortunately didn’t get to meet Brian but Erica showed a serious interest in us as guests and was so excited over every aspect of our trip. 11/10 would recommend and 100% would go back again in the future.
Great location to hit up awesome breweries like New Holland, Jolly pumpkin (favorite), founders and people cider co. And only 45 minutes away from amazing beaches like Grand Haven and Saugatuck.
Brian and Erica place was amazing and is so close to many places in walking distance

We had a wonderful stay! What a beautiful and unique condo! We really enjoyed the amenities such as the rooftop pool and private deck off the rooftop pool! There are some really good and quality places nearby that we were able to walk to! Brian and Erica are wonderful hosts. Even though this was a shared space, you would have never known! They are very welcoming and thoughtful with many little personal touches. They also know a lot about the area, which really helps when you’re unsure where to start. Thank you both again!
Such a stylish room with such attention to artistic detail. Close to the downtown and major interstates for quick navigation around Grand Rapids!
The location is wonderful. Walking distance from numerous restaurants and bars. The rooftop pool and hot tub was well kept.
There really is nothing more you could ask for. Brian and Erica were great hosts.

Erica was a Great host! Easily approachable and very helpful. Gave us our privacy and available when needed. I had some trouble with the stairs but Erica helped me with my luggage. Very pleasant host! Gave us tips on where to eat and shop. Thank you!

My wife and I stayed here as a one-night layover passing through from Mackinac to Indiana. It was a great choice. The condo is really easy to get to being right next to 131. Finally, Brian and Erica were really cool and flexible hosts when it came time to check in and get settled. Thanks for the great stay!

Brian and Erica's third floor guest suite is a haven in downtown Grand Rapids. They have everything you need at and around their wonderful condo. It is within walking distance to worthwhile restaurants, breweries, and a distillery. They are warm and accommodating, making it feel like you are staying with extended family, rather than at an airbnb.

Brian and Erica's place was amazing! Super cute and great location. They gave great suggestions on what to do in Grand Rapids, showed us around the building, and were very friendly. Highly recommend staying here!

Everything was AMAZING. The bed and pillows are very comfortable. The space was very clean and accommodating. They had many thoughtful touches from the snacks and local beer to the decorations and historical pride. Brian and Erica always had a smile and were genuinely kind. They were courteous of our private space. Oh and I can’t forget to mention the incredible rooftop pool, hot tub, and community space. We will definitely be coming back for another stay!
Wonderful stay in GR! Fantastic accommodations and super hosts!!
Brian and Erica are amazing hosts and this place is beautiful. You have access to the pool also and you are basically right in the middle of downtown grand rapids. 10/10 would recommend
Amazing place to stay. Close to bars and restaurants! We didn’t get to enjoy the rooftop pool and hot-tub we will take advantage of it next time!

The only mistake that you will make in booking this property is not staying long enough to enjoy all of the amenities of this historic building and fantastic location for exploring downtown Grand Rapids! We did not get to meet Brian, but Erica is a wealth of enthusiastic knowledge of all of the cool places to visit and great places to eat in the area. We had really great weather so we were able to walk downtown for a concert at DeVos Center. We could have easily explored all of downtown had we had more time.

The cleanliness, comfort and layout of the space that you will use are exceptional. The bedroom is not only all of the above but pitch black dark and super quiet, ensuring a great night sleep. The bathroom and lounge area are perfect if one of you, like me, gets up before the other. The hosts provide hot and cold beverages and snacks suitable for all times of day.

Communication is excellent, as is safe and secure parking. The uniqueness of this conversion of a high school from a bygone era into luxury lofts is an experience that we love about Airbnb and generous hosts like Brian and Erica. We will be back!

A very nice space in a beautiful historic building in a great part of Grand Rapids. Erica and Brian ore wonderful hosts although we seldom saw them. They offered excellent suggestions for dining and drinks and helped make Grand Rapids a great place to visit, surprisingly (for me) nice. The near west side location is convenient to downtown and the convention center and is loaded with trendy yet good restaurants and night spots.

THIS PLACE IS OUTSTANDING. It is one of the coolest building renovations I have ever seen. On top of being an incredible space, the hosts are incredible. So accommodating and friendly! They left a basket of snacks, and chocolates by the bedside as well. Did I mention the pool/hot tub on the roof?! What a view! Central location, walking distance to incredible food, drinks, and activities, I could go on and on. All we could say is “wow” after we arrived. Highly recommend this amazing place.
Very comfortable stay. Great location, felt like home! Can’t wait to visit again soon.

Brian and Erica we’re awesome hosts and their place is hip, cool, clean and stylish. So if you’re looking for a place that embodies GR’a vibe their place is it! Minutes away from Jolly Pumpkin, New Holland and other microbrews and restaurants.
Gorgeous accommodations! Brian and Erica were wonderful hosts. We left a day early due to an upcoming ice storm and they were incredibly flexible.

Beautiful condo. It was to cold for us to talk advantage of the pool and hot tub, but the views were beautiful from the roof top. Walking distance to a couple of brewery's and restaurants. Brain and Erica were very nice and helpful. We will be visiting again.

Brian and Erica were so helpful and accommodating! The building is an old, renovated high school, and their apartment has so many cool touches from the original building. Brian gave me a great tour of the building to show me the amenities (gym, pool, hot tub, community room), so I felt right at home. They left a basket of goodies for me, and had offered many helpful tips about local restaurants and bars.

This is a very unique space. The hot tub was great and the brow from the private loft was very cool. Erica and Brian were very gracious hosts and gave us great recommendations for food and drink. The building is just a short walk to Jolly Pumpkin, Butcher’s Union and other great places to eat and drink.
Brian and Erica’s place was great! The rooftop hot tub was amazing, and it is a great location for exploring Grand Rapids.

We had a great short stay! The space was so cute felt very private. The bone was located within a 5 minute walk to like 4 breweries and a bunch of bars and restaurants. Our hosts were so great and had great recommendations that we checked out. We didn’t use the hot tub but the game room was so cool! I will definitely be back once it’s warmer with my boyfriend!!

Erica and Brain were great! They have all the details taken care of (parking, towels, snacks) and the space is amazing. Absolutely loved the roof-top hot tub that overlooked the city and the ability to walk to my destinations.

Brian and Erica are great. They made check-in easy and showed us around the building, which is an interesting piece of local history. They have put a lot of thoughtful touches into the rented space, including information about the history of the building and even have an old year book from the school. We have never stayed in a rented space within someone else’s space before, only whole houses or apartments for rent. They made themselves available but we hardly noticed that they were around. We felt comfortable and safe staying there. The building is close to restaurants and the Van Andel Arena via foot or Uber. The photos are an accurate depiction of the space. I would definitely recommend this place to friends.

Brian and Erica were super hosts and the place was beautiful, clean and unique. The location was great and they were very helpful with check in and offering to help with bags and getting us settled in. We had never used AirBnB before and our experience with Brian and Erica will definitely have us using this service again. I would highly recommend them to anyone visiting the Grand Rapids area.
Great place and would highly recommend!

Brian and Erica’s place was truly unique. We loved it! Erica gave us a tour of the building and tips for local eateries which was very helpful. The treats and drinks were a nice touch and much appreciated! We would certainly go back!

Spot on in their description! They were great people and really tried to make our first Airbnb experience excellent! They had great suggestions for dining/drinks, responded very quickly, and had a great place to enjoy! We especially loved the hot tub and location. Short lyft/uber to almost anywhere - or walk to downtown which is what we did :) Excellent hosts and home!!!
Great place to stay! Hosts are friendly and helpful. We will definitely go back and recommend to friends. This was our first AirB&B and we loved it!
Brian and Erica are amazing hosts, the place is unique and beautiful and the location is amazing. I will definitely be back when I’m in town.

Great location, 2 blocks from New Holland Brewery, the hot tub was awesome overlooking Grand Rapids. Brian and Erica are awesome, they make you feel welcome, it was like coming home to stay with the closest of family. Our first Airbnb experience and it was a home run!
Great people

Brian & Erica were amazing!!! They were so sweet and extremely accommodating. Everything about our stay was made easy (with their help). The space was beautiful, private, and spacious. We loved the snacks, lovely decor, and the hot tub. I would stay again! :)

This is such a unique place to stay. Super-cool old building, great hot tub (and probably pool, but we were there in February), very comfortable. We aren't familiar with GR, so the hosts' tips (when to drive, when to Uber, good restaurants, etc.) were so helpful (and accurate!). Brian and Erica were so hospitable. This is a cool alternative to a ho-hum hotel.
Staying here is a must!!!!
Great place to stay..will be back!

Brian and Erica have a beautiful condo in a really cool historic building on the west side. It's very central and walkable to some great restaurants and bars. They are fantastic hosts, hospitable and friendly. I was only there for one night for a business trip and wish I had more time to spend there. Highly recommended!

I stayed here for 3 week nights on a business trip. It was a great value. Quiet place to chill and rest each evening. Fantastic hosts. Close to good restaurant choices. I’m sure I’ll stay here again when I’m in town.

Brian and Erica's place is really the best you can hope to find. As a guest, you have your own little lofted area that's well-lit (with that massive window) and extremely cozy. The hosts don't miss a beat at making you feel at home -- the guest living area has a mini fridge stocked with drinks, a basket of snacks, a coffee maker, a TV, and books galore. I genuinely enjoyed staying here and I'd do it again in a heartbeat.
On top of it all, they're really, really nice people.
Amazing host and local! They treated us like family! All of the local tips we could want! Very accommodating and caring!

Brian and Erica went above and beyond for us. Erica helped pull off my surprise proposal to my now fiancé! We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and we will definitely be staying with them again!

Brian and Erica define what AirBnb hosts should be. They are so welcoming, genuinely interested in the lives of their guests, and provide the most gracious hospitality. They have a great knowledge of the area and community and are more than happy to share ideas and suggestions. Their home is beautiful as well and very enjoyable to spend time in. When we return to GR for a night, we will be booking with Brian and Erica again. I highly recommend a stay with them.

Great place in a perfect location. The loft is very cozy and has everything you could need. Brian and Erica are amazing hosts and we’re a pleasure to deal with! We would highly recommend this place to everyone!

Was probably one of the most amazing experiences and weekends I've had in a very long time. Beautiful townhouse with special amenities and touches! Brian and Erica took great interest in getting to know me. Went above and beyond to suggest things to do in the city, and are truly amazing individuals. I feel like I'm part of their family and look forward to my next stay with them!

Erica and Brian were great hosts - quick communication when we booked, and meaningful recommendations of places to go. Their spot is very clean, interesting, and a few minute walk from several restaurants, like the Knickerbocker. The "architectural gem" is true!
We loved staying at Brian and Erica's place! They are very warm and welcoming and knowledgeable about Grand Rapids! We would highly recommend staying with them!
We thought the space was very modern and comfortable. Our hosts were amazing and very flexible. We would definitely recommend them and would love to stay again!

This place is incredible. A private room that felt like my own place. Brian and Erica were amazing, gave me great tips for the immediate neighborhood and much more beyond. The neighborhood has many restaurants and bars, and was quick to walk to, even in winter. I'm hoping very much that their place is available when I return for work next year. They 100% have a repeat customer in me.

Hosts like Brian & Erica are what make Airbnb great. Their loft in an old school is simply amazing, the bed was cozy, and they had plenty of coffee, drinks and snacks waiting for us. Best of all, you’re a short walk from GR’s hottest breweries and restaurants. The only thing we regret is not booking another night!
Beyond comfortable, great location and amazing amenities! Wish we could have stayed longer.

I had a great time (and overall, probably one if my best AirBnb experiences so far). Erica and Brian are the most friendly hosts imaginable and the beautiful space and room left absolutely nothing left to be desired. Thank you!

Brian & Erica’s place is awesome. The apartment complex itself is incredibly unique and we had a great time on the tour Erica gave us. We ended up getting in pretty late to meet them and Erica was more than accommodating to stay up to wait for us to let us in. The accommodations were clean, the snacks were a very, very welcome bonus; and the area was a great place to start our adventure on our first day in Grand Rapids. We would definitely come back!

Brian and Erica provide a warm welcome to a beautiful lodging experience. Architecturally interesting, visually appealing, full of fun, quirky design elements, their loft is a great place to stay close to Grand Rapids city center. I want to return and take my husband along just to hang out with Brian and Erica!

Everything was wonderful! Mike and I really enjoyed our stay at Brian & Erica’s place. They provide all that’s necessary for a comfortable and nice stay. All the little details added even more fun to the adventure. We mentioned we came to Grand Rapids, MI mainly to check out breweries and Erica even surprised us with a couple of good cold beers from Founders Brewing Co. Beautiful place, very clean and a very comfortable bed!! Excellent communication from beginning to end. Totally recommended! Thank you guys.

I stayed with Erica and Brian during a quick (1 night) business trip to Grand Rapids. I had a lovely stay and really enjoyed exploring the West Side neighborhood while I was there. The space is beautiful, very comfortable, and clean. Thoughtful touches and wonderful hospitality. I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Brian and Erica were great hosts, very helpful and considerate during our stay. We were in town for the Grand Rapids marathon, and Brian went above and beyond by seeing us to the start line of the race. Their loft was a comfortable, but unique space in a quiet neighborhood that is still in close proximity to downtown. We would stay there again in a heartbeat.

This is a private room but does feel more like your own place. We had the whole third floor to ourselves, with a great sitting area. Brian and Erica were phenomenal hosts. They gave us great recommendations of where to eat and enjoy cocktails in the neighborhood. They added special touches like a bottle of wine for our anniversary. We loved being able to use the rooftop hot tub overlooking the city and enjoyed Brian and Erica's amazing loft home. I would highly recommend staying in this Airbnb.

Our stay was very short, but Brian and Erica were excellent hosts. They made us feel immediately welcome and at home, and were helpful and hospitable. Their place is beautiful and has a great atmosphere. Located centrally, downtown was a short walk away. Very classy couple and home, and great value for the price. Would definitely recommend this to others.

Brian and Erica were very gracious hosts. Their suggestions for restaurants and bike routes were very helpful. The neighborhood nearby has a number of unique bars and restaurants. We left our car and bicycles locked in the secure parking and walked to dinner. Brian and Erica's place is truly unique. As stated, it is on the second level of a former high school. The loft is on the second level of the unit. From the front door of the building to your bedroom there are three flights of steps and several long hallways to traverse. Keep in mind that the loft is open to the family living space below not very private. For those who are accustomed to sharing space through Airbnb, you will feel right at home. Overall it was a great stay.
Super friendly, cool people! I felt like they were friends as well as hosts.

Brian and Erica were excellent hosts! The loft area is private and cozy. There are so many restaurants and bars in walking distance and others are just a quick Uber today. Highly recommended. We will come back!
The space was comfortable, cool and in a good location . The real treat is Erica. She was so responsive, accommodating and fun.

Erica and Brian's place is absolutely beautiful. We were a bit nervous about staying in a shared space but the loft is easily accessible and feels completely separate. Erica was amazing and met us to show us around. We used the rooftop pool area and hot tub and really enjoyed watching the sunset from the roof. The loft area is gorgeous, comfortable and exactly as described. I can't wait for our next visit to Grand Rapids because we will definitely stay again!

Loved that this was an historic building repurposed!!! It was fun to see how an old brick school was transformed into beautiful, upscale loft apartments. Erica provides an old year book from 1937, as well as a Class of 67 Reunion booklet, which really was enjoyable to look through while sitting in the almost magical transformation. Erica was very sweet and her help with navigating the property was appreciated. Love her decorating... love her cute elephant sheets and hand soap.
Brian & Erica are excellent hosts, and have a very beautiful home.
Brian & Erica are great hosts. The location has many restaurants within walking distance. After a day of sightseeing, it was really nice to come back to such a wonderful condo.

Brian and Erica were so welcoming and their place is amazing. It was raining the first day we were there which was a great excuse to use the hot tub! We were welcomed with beer which was fantastic and the location was amazing to complete the Brewmaster challenge and to explore in general. Loved the apartment (special mention to the elephant sheets!) and Brian and Erica. Thanks guys, hope to see you again in the future!
Brian & Erica are amazing hosts. They make you feel very welcome and are extremely helpful. They will make sure your stay is as memorable as possible. Would definitely recommend a stay with them!

Although I don't personally believe in perfection, I do believe that Brian and Erica's home comes as close to perfection as possible for an Airbnb! The hospitality and kindness that was shown to us by Brian and Erica in just over 24 hours is impossible to adequately express through words. My brother's favorite TV characters were doing a show in Grand Rapids the night before his 30th birthday, so our decision to make the trip from Ohio/Pennsylvania was a no-brainer. We've also never taken a road trip with just the two of us so our excitement had been building for months. Staying with Brian and Erica was the best decision we could have possibly made. After briefly mentioning his birthday to them, they made every effort, quite successfully, to make our celebratory trip unforgettable. As soon as we arrived, Erica began taking pictures to commemorate our weekend. We were first introduced to the beautiful building and their extraordinary loft. They then gifted my brother with a delicious bottle of cider and two cigars. After receiving food recommendations, we headed out for the evening. Upon our return we spent the evening in the hot tub, enjoying the splendid view of Grand Rapids. We returned to the hot tub and pool in the morning before heading out. The kindness, generosity, and hospitality shown to us during our stay will not soon be forgotten, from what was previously mentioned to countless other things such as fresh fruit and snacks. If we ever find ourselves in Grand Rapids again, there is nowhere else we'd consider staying!
Erica and Brian were the perfect hosts. The rooftop deck and pool were wonderful!
Best quick trip ever. Great location. We would absolutely recommend a stay here.
This was our first experience with an AirBnB. Normally, we are not BnB type people, but the unit was located in a old high school building that we had graduated from in 1967.

The unit is located within a tree level condo. It occupies the top level so be prepared for stairs: no handicap access. This is not a lock out, so you will be in the families living space. The unit occupies the entire top level and includes a bedroom, bath w/ shower and sitting area that includes TV, small fridge, and amenities like coffee, snack bars, fruit.

The hosts, Brian and Erica were great people. As a matter of fact once we checked in, we saw little of them through-out our four day stay. They took us on a tour of the facility and made sure that we understood how to maneuver the complex. We had our own set of keys and an access fob that granted us access to the building and parking.

The unit is located in a gentrified area of Grand Rapids and is within walking distance of downtown activities and restaurants. The price was very competitive with hotels in the immediate area. What is interesting is that Brian and Erica donate a portion of their proceeds to help neighborhood non-profits.
Bottom line... If you are an AirBnB type and are looking for a space near the Grand Rapids area, we think you'll find this a thumbs-up.

The space was great! You get your own floor. Bedroom Bathroom and little living room area all private, and Brian gave us some good advice on restaurants to try! Mini fridge and coffee maker in living room was nice! Definitely would come back 😊

We had a phenomenal stay at Brian and Erica's place in GR. Of all the Airbnb hosts we've met, Brian and Erica were by far the friendliest and most accommodating. Be sure to ask for a list of recommendations from them-my Fiancé and I had a 2-person bar and restaurant crawl and had a blast! Would highly recommend staying here.
Perfect hosts!

Cozy private loft within walking distance of some of the most incredible breweries & restaurants Grand Rapids has to offer. Combine this with the gracious hosts and low-cost and you get a deal that's hard to beat. A+
The loft is perfect! Super soundproof bedroom. Bathroom with deluxe amenities.
Erica always left me fresh fruit and a plentiful basket of goodies! The jacuzzi is great and the location is walking distance to all. Couldn't have been better! Let's vex it.

This is a beautiful location that is unique in its design and decoration. The unit is immaculate and well maintained. It is a multi-level unit so be prepared to climb stairs. The on-site amenities (the pool, deck, community room, and exercise room) are top notch. The building that the unit is located in is on the west side of Grand Rapids in an area that is primarily residential. While downtown GR is only a few minutes away, it's not really walkable. Parking is located directly across the street and is secure but it fills up quickly at night and spaces are a little tight (we were driving a full size truck).

The hosts are very friendly and helpful. Our hostess spent a sizable amount of time with us, showing us around the unit and the building and even took us across the street to show us how to get in and out of the parking area.
Wonderful place to stay! Great hospitality, owners are very helpful and friendly!! Highly recommend staying here for your next AirBnb in Grand Rapids!!
Erica's place was great for stay in great rapids. Good location and amenities. Recommended

My wife had a very nice time at their house. They were incredibly accommodating.They room and space were comfortable and she enjoyed the terrace and very short walk to an unforgettable dinner. She had to leave very early the next day and the host did not mind showing her out and getting the key from her on their weekend.
Excellent location, hosts were so kind and accommodating. The pool is amazing. Everything was clean and beautiful
Great host and the apartment is beautiful!
Great couple! Very classy and welcoming

Erica and Brian were supreme hosts! Their home is exceedingly spectacular. The amenities are wonderful and the bed is awesome! Great sleep. Their home was our last stop on our honeymoon and they allowed us much privacy and comfort and yet very welcoming and inviting. Erica has a genuine loving spirit and we connected and consider them like family. You will not regret your stay in their home.
This place is an absolute gem! The building itself has so much character and Erica and Brian are the best hosts!
They gave us all the privacy we needed but also took us out for a great night of fireworks cocktails and beers!
The loft is fantastic and is basically a little private apartment above their home. It is clean, quiet and comfortable with so so much character.
We will definitely stay again!
Beautiful place! Highly recommend
Excellent hosts!

First time going to grand rapids and we had a blast! The place itself was very nice and historic, used to be a high school. It's walking distance to several bars and restaurants which was a huge plus. The rooftop deck had a pool and hot tub which was nice! The room was nice with a comfy queen sized bed and we had our own bathroom and loft. Brian and Erica were awesome hosts and even got us a gift for our one year anniversary which was very sweet of them. Definitely would recommend others to stay here

My wife and I had a great week at this amazing accommodation. The location is perfect with just a short walk to some great bars and restaurants, when not sampling what the local bars had to offer we spent our time in the rooftop pool and hot tub. Our hosts Brian and Erica were great and I'm sure we will be returning again at some point in the future.
Super accommodating, very clean accommodations in a nice area with private parking. The hosts are great and so are the breweries and restaurants in the immediate area.

Brian and Erica are exceptionally friendly and welcoming hosts. They are passionate advocates for the revitalization of their neighborhood and take great pleasure in being your personal tour guides. It was a real treat to stay in their unusual but lovely home and to learn more about (and enjoy) Grand Rapids "west-side".

Brian and Erica's place was a great place to stay while visiting breweries in Grand Rapids. Brian was very nice and showed us around at check-in, the building is unique and has lots of amenities. We were able to walk to some breweries nearby, otherwise we took an Uber which was reasonably priced. The bedroom was dark, comfortable and quiet, perfect for getting rest after a long day. We would recommend their place to others and would book again in he future!
Erica & Brian were wonderful hosts. Erica was our main contact and she has a warm and inviting energy to her; she was inclusive while still giving us the space we needed.

The space itself was comfortable and clean. You have an entire floor including the bedroom, a bathroom & living space which includes a TV, couch & mini fridge. You do have to go up two sets up stairs to get the the bedroom once in the condo so something to consider for those that have difficulty with stairs.
Brian and Erica's place was great!! So welcoming, and location was within walking distance of everything you need to experience Grand Rapids. Thank You.
Super hosts, really enjoyed my stay here. A lovely home, very close to downtown and lots of good bars and restaurants. Fresh fruit, snacks, and drinks were a great bonus!
Great place to stay in the heart of Grand Rapids. Hosts Erica and Brian are on the go. We felt very well cared for.

Great place to stay in the heart of Grand Rapids. The hosts Erica and Brian give full throttle. We felt very well cared for. Thank you very much for your stay with us. We enjoyed the hospitality very much! Everything worked out best. We can only recommend this property!
Place was wonderful! Brian & Erica were great hosts

My wife and I stayed here on our way to Michigan's Upper Peninsula and we loved it. The setting in an old schoolhouse is so unique and the room is very comfortable and well stocked. Erica met us outside and gave us a tour of the building including the rooftop deck and hot tub. The location is great and close to many restaurants. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.
Look no further! Brian and Erica's condo was wonderful and would definitely stay again! Thank you for being such a great, super welcoming host!
Place was so clean, comfortable, walking distance to just about everything. You will not be let down! This is a must if your in the area!

I felt like I hit the jackpot picking this Air BNB. Brian and Erica could not be kinder and more welcoming. The whole condo is very cool and the space you get is fabulous. You have your own bedroom, bathroom and a living area that is private. In the living space they have a mini fridge where they leave you some bottled water, soda and some beer. They also leave you fresh fruit, granola bars, chips, and pop tarts! The bathroom was stocked with quality bath products. I had a new Bliss body scrub, shampoo, and body butter, as well as several other high end options. The bed is crazy comfortable. They give you extra sheets and a ton of clean towels. It Took me about 15 minutes to walk from their place to my conference at the Courtyard by Marriott in downtown. It was just over five dollars to take an Uber. I would most definitely stay with them again. Thanks for everything Erica and Brian!Staying at Brian and Erica's Loft was fantastic! Check-in was simple and hassle free. They have a beautiful home with plenty of private space for an affordable price. Will definitely see if they are available for future stays in Grand Rapids.

Staying with Brian & Erica was our first experience with an Air B&B so we were a bit nervous, but it was wonderful! We had the entire upper floor to ourselves and their home was lovely. We will stay again!

Beautiful condo in a very unique building. Great neighborhood. Erica was very friendly and accommodating. She offered many different suggestions for places to check out in the neighborhood. Easy check in and check out!!

Erica and Brian's place was fabulous! It was clean and spacious. The bed was super comfortable and the snacks and treats in the fridge for us were so appreciated. This was our best AirBNB experience and it was thanks to our kind hosts. So many cool breweries and restaurants just around the corner from their place. Loved every minute of it and would highly recommend!!
This place was as near to perfect as possible. Great location as all of downtown is walkable. The hosts are amazing. Your search for a place to stay in GR should end here.

Brian and Erica were great! They were very welcoming and enthusiastic to have us. Their home is lovely and comfortable. It's the perfect place to allow for exploration of the city: within walking distance of both the Westside and Downtown areas as well as proximal to the expressways.
Brian & Erica's apartment is great! If you want to sleep in an old school in the sports hall you should take this place. Both are very friendly and the apartment is quite big.

Erica and Brian were wonderful hosts. Their home was so cozy and tastefully decorated. The private 3rd floor was super cozy and housed everything we needed and more, for a weekend. They were super friendly and offered many suggestions and gave us a tour around Union square. The townhouse is located walking distance to New Holland Brewing and many other breweries and places to eat. It is also just a very, very short drive to downtown. I highly recommend this airbnb to everyone.

While we didn't get the chance to meet Erica, Brian was absolutely accommodating. He offered a wonderful tour of the building and was very knowledgeable on the area and places, bars and restaurants to visit. The bedroom and loft couldn't have been more perfect for our needs! Be sure to set an alarm because you can easily oversleep in the "sensory deprivation" bedroom. The bed and bedroom couldn't have been more comfortable. :)

I wasn't able to meet Brian, but Erica was gracious, hospitable, and helpful. She has a wealth of knowledge about the area, and the location was ideal for walking to/from restaurants, etc. Access to amenities in their building was a nice touch: rooftop deck/pool/hottub, community room, fitness room.

What everyone else is saying: a great location to explore the city, your own well-equipped private suite on the condo's top level with baskets of munchies and all the amenities you might need, topped off by the ultra-warm and accommodating hosting of Brian and Erica. Big plus for us: restaurants, breweries, and music are just a five-minute walk, on Bridge Street.
Grand Rapids Michigan is a great downtown and West Side.

Grand Rapids is also one of the few towns whereby Airbnb hosts must live on the property.If you're staying in Grand Rapids, this is the place you want to be! Perfect location, easy access to local hot spots, beautifully decorated, very clean and accommodating, this place has it all. Brian and Erica were amazing hosts. So warm and friendly, they went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. We will definitely be back!
Wonderful stay. Perfect location. Beautiful place to stay. Hot tub was open. But was so busy didn't get to use it Ericka and Brian are the perfect hosts
Amazing hosts, provides a safe, warm, loving environment and energy! Can't wait to come back soon! We loved it. Thank you so much Brian and Erica!

Brian & Erica were absolutely great! We only planned on staying one night but decided to stay a second based on the time we had. The room was very private and felt home'y. Brian and Erica had great connections and recommendations which we used to have an even better stay than we anticipated. Very cool location. Felt right at home. Highly recommend!

Wow where do we even begin! The space was absolutely awesome. You have the entire third floor to yourself, I stayed with a coworker and Erica set up an inflatable mattress in the loft which was totally comfortable. The loft has a fully stocked coffee maker, huge bowl of all sorts of snacks and a fridge full of water, sodas and beer for the guests. Nice touch! The kitchen was fully stocked with any utensil or appliances we could have needed and the living room and balcony were just lovely. Highlight of the trip for us was hanging in the hottub with some local (provided by Erica and Brian) on a night where it snowed all day! Coolest experience ever! The building itself is just breathtaking and beyond cool. You are less than 20 min walk to city center and there are tons of restaurants and breweries just down the street from the building. Brian and Erica are such interesting, giving and lovely people who took such an interest to us. Their give back initiative is amazing and they tailor each donation to their guests. We were in town with a touring musical so they are donating to local arts education. How cool is that? Needless to say, I couldn't recommend them more. 6 stars!
My sister and I enjoyed our one night stay in this property, perfect for a girl getaway! Brian and Erica were great!

As always Brian and Erica went above and beyond as hosts. I bought this stay at their place as part of a wedding gift for relatives and they made it so special for them. The communication is always top notch as well as the accommodations. They spoil their guests making it difficult for other places to compete! They are amazing in hospitality! We will be back and will definitely recommend to others!

Brian and Erica were both very accommodating and welcoming! Everything was very clean, comfortable as well as relaxing and fun! The hot tub was open and has a great view of the city. The fitness room was nice. Being down the road from a few restaurants and shops was nice as well!!
Brian and Erica were fantastic hosts.
Their place was lovely and was a great place to stay.

Brian and Erica were terrific hosts! They checked me in and were very friendly and showed me the grounds. The loft area was very comfortable and I greatly appreciated the drinks/snacks they made available. Overall the stay was great and I hope to stay with Brian and Erica again.
Best hosts ever!

Erica and Brian are such amazing hosts! We arrived late after a long drive and they were more than accommodating. Their home is so lovely and even though we were in town to go on a beer tour, both my wife and I agree that the best part of the trip was when we were to relax in the lofted space. They are absolutely amazing and we would highly recommend staying with them!

Grand Rapids is a super walkable town! Brian and Erica are full of suggestions for where to eat and hang out. You get the feeling of being a local when you can just come & go at your leisure. The space was private, amazingly decorated and super comfortable.

My girlfriends and I LOVED our time here. Brian was great (Erica was out of town) and made us feel welcomed and comfortable. The loft was very spacious and private, and we immediately felt at home. I have stayed in GR in many different hotels, but this was by far my favorite stay. We definitely will be back here!
Brian was friendly, informative and accommodating. Nice private room located close to downtown. Would stay again.

Erica and Brian were awesome hosts! My flight was delayed and I didn't get to their place until after midnight. Erica still met me at the door and got me settled, and was incredibly patient and welcoming. The room is extremely comfortable, and is an excellent sleeping nook if you're in need of catching up on z's. The space was roomy, private, and had everything (and more!) that I needed. Bath products and snacks were so appreciated. The building is safe, comfortable, easy to get in and out of, and very simple for catching ubers or taxis. The neighborhood is fun, and has some stellar yoga, coffee, beer, and food to offer. Also great for running along the river. Very close proximity to the medical center. The room is lovely, welcoming, incredibly comfortable, and feels very safe. Absolutely recommend!

We had a fantastic night with Brian and Erica. Parking was a piece of cake, the entire building had a great feel, and it was all situated in an ideal location in downtown Grand Rapids.
