I was in town for business, not pleasure, which involved early mornings and late nights, and they were perfectly fine with that, never making me feel uncomfortable with the prospect of arriving home after they had turned in for the night.

Much nicer than the vast majority of hotels I stay at. I had a private room on the third floor with a comfortable bed and a desk. Plenty of room in the closet to hang my clothes and empty drawers for me to unpack.

Actually, it was more like a suite . . . a private bathroom on the 3rd floor and a small den for my use, complete with a coffee maker, small refrigerator stocked with some nice beverages, some snacks and fruit, and a sofa/TV.
Location was great. 15- to 20-minute walk to downtown, and plenty to see in the immediate neighborhood.

I left at the ungodly hour of 4:00 a.m., and when I was quietly leaving, I noticed the baklava that Erica had wrapped for me to take as a parting gift. ll definitely stay with Brian and Erica . . . wonderful hosts who offer a rare combination of being friendly and warm, but also very respectful of your privacy.

Bryan and Erica were such great hosts! They were having a "pop up party" on Friday night when we arrived and invited my girlfriend, Danielle, and I to join. We had planned to go out on the town, but decided we were having too much fun with our hosts to leave. That night we enjoyed the rooftop hot tub and when we finally made it to bed, it was very comfortable. The guest bedroom and loft were very comfortable and loaded with drinks and treats. They knew it was Danielle's birthday celebration and had supplied us with some of her favorite beer, chocolate, and cookies. They laid out maps and a program for ArtPrize and also offered several suggestions for things to do. They again invited us out to lunch and dinner with them multiple times during our weekend. The condos are located within walking distance from downtown and there is also uber, lyft, and spokefly (bicycle rental) available throughout the city. I can't say enough about Erica and Brian. They just go so far out of their way to make you feel like family. To be clear, if you are looking to have your own space, it is completely available to you as well. We simply made the choice to spend some time with them because they are great to be around. It was an incredible experience and Union High will be our go-to crash pad for future Grand Rapids get aways whenever possible!

Best place to experience a wonderful Airbnb stay! My 2nd stay with Erica & Brian was great. They are thoughtful, sensitive hosts who offer great suggestions for enjoying a visit to Grand Rapids. Accommodations are top-notch. Thanks so much!
Erica and Brian went above and beyond any standards that I knew from pervious AirBnB stays. I highly recommend their place.

You want to stay at this very very nice Union Square Condo... Brian was such a top notch host... The place was super clean and was such a fun time... The hosts gave us all the information about the condo and the city of GR to feel informed and get the most out of our trip. Thank You Brian!
There is the average Air BnB experience and then there is the exceptional. This is by far the exceptional - certainly the bar has been raised for all my travels. 11 out of 10 stars.
Both Erica and Brian were so accommodating and I appreciate all they did while I was there. Their place is great, clean and exactly as advertised (and more).
I would without a doubt stay there again.

Our stay with Erica and Brian was a wonderful experience both for our first time using Airbnb and our first time visiting Grand Rapids. After getting married my husband and I spent an entire week camping in the Upper Peninsula and a warm shower, an actual toilet and a warm bed was exactly what we needed. They were kind enough to let us do a load of laundry as soon as we arrived and left treats, a couple of local beers and a bottle of Michigan champagne in the mini fridge. They left suggestions on where to go and there were multiple games provided which were great after a hard day of hitting up some local breweries. All in all I would absolutely recommend Brian and Erica to any friends planning a visit to GR. Thanks for your warm hospitality! The pool, l hot tub and pool table were a perfect midday break from exploring a new city. Much love from Hamtramck!

One of the best Airbnb experiences I have had. Erica was so easy going & accommodating. She went out of her way to make sure our stay was great. She was a fantastic host offering up recommendations and tips on places to see. The room was extremely clean & comfortable. The building amenities were great plus. The rooftop pool & hot tub are a must see.

Erica and Brian welcomed us into their home as part of a birthday weekend celebration. Several emails passed between Erica and myself with details. She and Brian provided special details to our visit like birthday Oreos and special beverages. They provided several recommendations for food and activities. The accommodations more than met our expectations. A beautiful space within their unique condo. We especially liked their spirit of giving back to the community through their activity and donations. Very great site and wonderful hosts.

We had an awesome time staying with Erica and Brian while installing our sculpture for upcoming Artprize. The place is fantastic, nicely located downtown, and the hosts are more than perfect! We had a very pleasant overnight stay. The rooms are nicely prepared with works from prior Artprize Artists and have thoughtful details. Erica and Brian are great ambassadors for the urban Grand Rapids experience and offered excellent suggestions. The restaurant, The Black Heron down the street was a treat. I left feeling delighted with the city and ready to return in the very near future! Thank you!

Erica and Brian truly are world class hosts! My girlfriend and I stayed with Erica and Brian on our way to Detroit and our pit stop couldn't have been better. Upon arrival Erica and Brian showed us all the ins and outs of the Union Square complex which is a historic Grand Rapids high school that has been beautifully transformed into condos. Erica and Brian had everything ready for our arrival and go above and beyond to make sure that your stay feels like home. We would definitely stop by to stay with Erica and Brian again if our adventures ever take us back to Grand Rapids.

Erica and Brian were amazing hosts! The accommodations were not only exceptional in presentation, but amazingly comfortable as well. (We slept very well!) The living area is spacious and charming with plenty of storage space for your items. Even a super cool glass desk in the bedroom if you need to work. The sitting area has a couch, coffee maker and mini refrigerator. A LOT of nice touches. This property is so unique and the rooftop hot tub and swimming pool are an added bonus. In addition, this property is also very safe; complete with an on duty security guard. Erica and Brian were very helpful in making suggestions for things to do in the area and even spent time with us - they are very personable and genuinely FUN to be around. Having never been to Grand Rapids, we were pleasantly surprised by the many things to do in the area and their knowledge made us feel like we had our own personal concierge. We definitely will stay here again! Thank you so
Erica and Brian were gracious, knowledgeable, helpful hosts.
The space was comfortable, creatively furnished and conveniently located to downtown Grand Rapids venues.
This is a first class place. Everything was done from the initial contact to booking to meeting at the front door.
There home is spectacular as is the room I stayed in. This is centrally located to downtown Grand Rapids.
I can highly recommend Erica and Brian's as a comfortable and homey place to stay.

We had an awesome time at the loft! This place had so much to offer a guest. The hosts made us feel welcome and truly opened up their hearts and home to us. We were able to use the gym which had a variety of quality workout equipment to balance out eating our way through Grand Rapids. The loft was close enough where we were also able to walk pretty much everywhere. One of the most enjoyable pieces of our stay was to wake up early, have a coffee, and watch the sun come up through the large gymnasium window. We hope to be back sooner rather than later. The hosts definitely lived up to their reviews.

Firstly, Erica and Brian's home felt warm and welcoming. The space upstairs was quiet, comfortable and filled with books, games, music, just lots of fun stuff. They were also very accommodating. My flight got delayed by 3 hours, which meant I didn't check in until 3am, but Erica made herself available and had all the items I had requested ready for me when I finally arrived.

Secondly, this was a great location to stay, our only regret was not having enough time to explore the building. There's so much history with the home itself but due to time constraints, we missed out on some of the many amenities the building had to offer. So please plan to explore!

Lastly, Erica was very helpful in getting us situated with suggestions and giving us our privacy. We had everything we needed to make our stay very enjoyable. Overall, couldn't have asked for better hosts or a better location.

We had such a lovely time at Erica and Brian's loft. They were easy to communicate with before our arrival and so enthusiastic to have us there. It was truly a joy to learn about Union Square from Erica and take the tour of the historic building. Our stay was brief, but Erica and Brian were so hospitable, providing us with what we needed (including coffee and snacks) and then letting us enjoy the space ourselves. We felt very welcomed, but not overwhelmed. I just wish we could have stayed longer!

Everything about this stay was excellent. Excellent communication, met us promptly when we arrived. Gave us a tour of the building, offering their roof deck space to us. The accommodations were great, very private in a really interesting space. Erica and Brian are very nice people, and very helpful. We really enjoyed our stay, our new place in Grand Rapids. So much better than a generic hotel, plus they donate part of their airbnb income to charity, so we helped do some good also. After we left, Erica texted me to say she found a valuable pair of earrings that I left behind. I really appreciated her honesty and prompt text. Overall, just great, we highly recommend their listing.

Always a great stay. We enjoy the privacy of the upstairs loft sitting area, and the quiet dark bedroom. It is nice to have fresh fruit and some snack bars available as a to go snack. The mini-fridge with stocked water and other beverages is also so convenient. Good location with the river walk close enough to take a jog after a long day, or in the am. Easy access to highways, downtown. Erika and Brian are warm, friendly, and also very good about giving their guests their own time and space, as well as, welcoming them to spend time together. Always a good pick when in the Grand Rapids area.

This was our first Airbnb experience and it was great! Erica and Brian are perfect hosts and have put much thought into providing a relaxing atmosphere in their wonderful condo. Every detail was attended to from fresh flowers to nutritious snacks. Private space to stay in, even though it is in their home. Very close to downtown Grand Rapids which is so convenient when visiting this busy and awesome city!

Where to start?? Such great communication, so friendly and so full of energy - Brian and Erica just made me fall in love with Grand Rapids!! They opened their home and their lives to me and I got to experience a wonderful time with lots of smiles and laughter. We went to dinner, to see the view of the city with the night lights and out to the 'rainbow bridge' for some celebrating of marriage equality and music... They introduced me to some of their friends and they even welcomed my old college friend into the mix. I couldn't be more grateful for their positivity and on top of all that, the accommodations were impeccable - clean, full of snacks and thoughtful details and a killer pass to the rooftop pool/hot tub. The building was incredible as well with all of its history, a real gem of the city. Stay here, meet two amazing people who helped bring Airbnb to Grand Rapids and who are making such a difference in the world with their charity work as well. There is not enough room to share what a joyous and comfortable experience this was. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Erica and Brian!!!
Erica and Brian made Peter feel like a part of the family.

The host was fantastic at making me feel welcome. Brian and Erica communicated with me prior to my arrival and answered all my questions. They took a lot of time to show me around the building when I first arrived, gave me a list of places to eat, grocery shop, and a nice place for coffee in the morning. I stayed with them for there weeks and every day they made me feel welcome. I was able to go out in Grand Rapids with them a couple times, and they are fantastic people. Both of them are very outgoing and friendly. They get the highest recommendation possible from me. I hope that every airbnb experience I have in the future is as great as this one was.

The hosts made us feel extremely welcome. We arrived late on Friday evening, checked in with them, and within minutes of putting down our luggage, we were discussing an almost endless list of recommendations for local flavor and drinks. Over the course of the weekend, Erica and Brian continued to provide great recommendations to fill the gap left by the (unfortunate) weather.

The accomodations were just as described. We had plenty of space and the hosts were not obtrusive at all. The location was wonderful; the loft was contained in an old high school which had great architecture, amazing views of the city, and almost perfect proximity to almost anything you would want to do. Getting from stop to stop was easy with Uber. We truly couldn't have been more happy with our stay.

Beautiful home and spacious accommodations. Erica and Brian were perfect hosts - they set us up with everything we needed, gave us a tour of the building and great dinner recommendations, and then also let us have privacy. Couldn't have had a better experience in Grand Rapids. Thanks Erica and Brian!

Awesome stay with Erica and Brian, they are truly ambassadors for Grand Rapids (actually, their beloved West Side) and the airbnb experience! The space was immaculate and filled with thoughtful touches (fruit, wine, granola, chocolate, pampering shower products). They shared their knowledge of the neighborhood, and especially the history of the fabulous building they live in - a repurposed vintage school building. We had wonderful conversations, and I even got rides to work in the morning! I hope to have the chance to visit again. Highly highly recommended place to stay with fabulous hosts!!

What a great experience. Erica and Brian were amazing and accommodating hosts. The loft was perfect. I like airbnb because I don't like staying in hotels when I am traveling. I like being around people, but I also like my privacy (it's a dialectic, inside joke). At Erica & Brian's I had complete privacy, but I never felt alone; I enjoyed my host's company but I never felt like my space was infringed upon ... a perfect balance. I felt like I was visiting old friends, rather than meeting them for the first time.

The mini fridge in my private loft had cold drinks, fresh fruit and lots of snacks. The apartment is clean, fresh and has a great energy. The bed was comfortable with high quality sheets. Lots of fresh towels, shampoo & conditioner

The neighborhood is a bit industrial, I drove everywhere but I suspect I would have walked if the weather had been warmer. I had a few events downtown and it was literally 5 minutes away. The freeway access was super close, 1 turn and perhaps two stop lights.
Highly recommended. You can't go wrong.

I had stayed with Brian and Erica before so, after I meet up with Brian on check in we spent a little time catching up. I went up to the loft and Erica had remembered I like granola and had a bag by the fridge. I unpacked and as I say down on the bed, for a moment I felt like I was back home. The loft is better than advertised, private yet open. The school is in a great location to venture into downtown or explore the growing neighborhood around it. Gated parking for my car at night, and the only worry is if it the loft will be free to book the next time I need to stay.

Had a great one night stay at Brian and Erica's. The suite on the third floor of this old high school is very private, so if you're concerned about a room, don't be. The bedroom, which is in the back of the suite is dark and quiet--which was unexpected for a building with three story windows! Great sleeping!

Brian and Erica were gracious hosts, made us very comfortable and were helpful when we needed them--responsive to texts and questions. We enjoyed some time on the building's pool deck and also getting lost in the old building. For architecture fans, staying in this building is a treat. The suite is at the top of what was the boy's gym of the school--super interesting!

Erica and Brian could not have been more accommodating or friendly. The facilities surpassed the description and we had a wonderful time staying at 600 Broadway. thanks for the wonderful stay - we will be back!

My sister & I had a fantastic time staying with Brian&Erica! Our trip was somewhat last minute but they were SO accommodating and quick to respond. We were there for an event & to celebrate my 30th bday, and Erica went out of her way to make sure our stay was perfect. She met us curbside upon arrival & although we had been unsure of what to expect, her friendly, carefree attitude put us at ease immediately. She gave us a quick tour before showing us to our suite so we could get ready. The whole townhouse is gorgeous, but the suite really shows guests just how much Erica enjoys hosting with all the little details; there were fresh flowers in every area, Ghiradelli chocolates on the nightstand, a mini fridge w/drinks, a coffee maker w/an assortment of K Cups, a basket of snacks, towels laid out (which were obviously new &super plush), and even a bottle of wine waiting for us! The suite is on the 3rd floor of the home, which means you need to be prepared to climb 2 flights of stairs whenever entering/exiting the suite area. This wasn't a big issue, although I probably would've left my larger luggage in the car to avoid having to lug it upstairs (which Brian graciously did for me). It was a bit warm in the room, but that was easily remedied by pulling out the nice table fan that was in the bedroom closet. The bed was incredibly comfortable, w/ soft sheets &nice pillows. This is the 1st time I've ever stayed in a room of someones home (vs renting the entire place) and although they were super friendly and very welcoming, i'll admit it was a little strange coming back after our night out& knowing that they were there sleeping. We weren't told which bedroom was theirs, but assumed it was the 2nd floor room w/the "Private" sign on the door, which was located directly under the suite. So that made us a little worried that we'd wake them up if we talked above a whisper or if our steps were too heavy. If you are used to the B&B type accommodations then you will be perfectly fine with that, and if not then staying with Brian&Erica would be a great way to try it out. They are fantastic hosts with an absolutely amazing suite in their beautiful home (located in a building that is by far the coolest place I've ever stayed in). I only wish we'd had more time to check out the building and surrounding area!

Erica and Brian were incredible! This was my first experience with AirBNB, so I was I little bit uncomfortable going in. I had a busy schedule, but when our paths did cross both were completely gracious and welcoming. I had easy access to the beautiful building, including a great workout room, a rooftop pool and hot tub, a comfortable community room, and free secure parking.

The bed was very comfy, the room was quiet, everything was well-appointed and clean. They even left me cold beverages in my own fridge. The entire experience was perfect. Erica and Brian are top-notch AirBNB-ers. I'll seek them out the next time I'm in GR.

Our stay with Erica and Brian was absolutely fantastic! They were so warm and welcoming!! Such a cute couple. Their place is beautiful and they instantly made us feel right at home. The room we stayed at was spacious and comfortable. The bathroom was clean and filled with so different products to use. The sitting room was incredibly cozy! They went above and beyond anything we could have expected! They were enjoyable to talk to. They are also extremely knowledgeable about Grand Rapids and good places to check out while in town. On top of that- they went out of their way to help us get around while we were in town! We loved staying with them!! Also, how can you go wrong with a rooftop hottub?

Brian and Erica were perfect hosts. They were very knowledgeable about the area and helpful when planning what to do in Grand Rapids. The loft unit was great, with lots of space, and amenities. Erica even stocked some granola for me off of a conversation when I booked. It's a really cool space, and Brian and Eric are great people. Defiantly would stay again.
OMG they were fantastic!... and Erica met us outside the re-vamped high school. She and Brian gave us a very detailed tour to acclimate us.

Once inside condo, well, candles are always a warm and cozy feel. Their condo was awesome w/the little extras in the loft a great "plus"! They were superb at guiding us on places to go/eat. 1 day felt like 1 year of knowing these two! We had a true friend connection and definitely plan on keeping in touch...hoping to also stay w/them during ArtPrize.
We had a great time staying with Erica and Brian! Erica met us at our arrival time with keys and a quick tour. She made us feel very welcome and offered great tips for visiting Grand Rapids.

Erica and Brian even adjusted our check in time because we were arriving early to attend a concert in town. The apartment is extremely clean and comfortable and anything you might need is provided (shampoo, conditioner, towels, etc.). The description is accurate. It is close to downtown which is a nice walk on a sunny day! Would definitely stay again and recommend them to anyone!

I stayed with Erica and Brian at Union square for one month and two weeks. Arriving in the cold of Michigan winter, I found a warm place hosted by people with a truly big heart. Erica and Brian are living the Air BnB theme with confidence and service I never had it before during an Air BnB stay.
An amazing place, clean, spacious, and hot tub + pool on the roof.
Both are fun people to hang out with. For beers, long conversations, laughter and always with recommendation where to go and to hang out.
I can highly recommend Erica’s and Brian’s space!’

Erica and Brian set the bar high as our first experience with airbnb! They were very welcoming and helpful. Many unexpected extras were provided (bday treats, snacks, drinks, bath products...). The building was great! We spent some time wandering around the old school taking in the historic details. Very cool. Overall fabulous experience; wish we could've stayed longer than two nights!

First time I had used Airbnb. Brian and Erica were the perfect hosts. I felt very much at home in their home. The historical building was fantastic. I am from a rural area, so my intro into city life was great, thanks to Brian & Erica.

Wonderful and welcoming! Erica and Brian and their home made for a perfect weekend getaway for my birthday. They went out of their way to have yummy treats in our room from local businesses. They also were very helpful in directing us to favorite places which we highly enjoyed. The space was comfortable and inviting, the history rich, the location easy and close to everything and the roof top hot tub was a true delight! I would wildly recommend this to anyone and have already!

Had been thinking about AirBnB for awhile, but had not signed up. Looked for last minute funeral trip lodging, but didn't know sign up/verification process can take a bit. So my first Air host was SOO welcoming even BEFORE I got there!! Erica helped me thru my tech challenges of verification quickly so I could stay at their lovely residence. If this doesn't say KUDOS for customer service & the types of hosts AirBnB has I don't know what does. Visit short & GREAT. Detailed welcome letter with easy to follow instructions & map. Gosh, couldn't be easier!! Photos don't do this unique residence justice & got to meet other host in same building. Would stay again at either listing. Felt like 5* hotel with great concierge. Hot tub on cold rooftop icing on cake. Erica made calls to a just named "best" restaurant in GR & got us in. Visit Erica & Brian when in GR, your suite is sweet & hosts delightful. I'm looking forward to my next Air BnB already.

I am not sure why my review was wisked away before completion. I was about to say that Erica and Brian are very savvy hosts and gave us a perfect combination of privacy and helpfulness. This overnight stay was very positive and very much a thumbs up experience.

I loved my stay at Erica and Brian's beautifully restored condo! Erica and Brian were extremely welcoming, friendly, attentive and were full of good advice about what to see and do in the fun city of Grand Rapids. Their loft space was private, spotless and so very comfortable, with loads of nice touches such as delicious coffee, fruit, lovely soaps, and every other amenity one could want.

Since I was in Grand Rapids on a difficult work assignment, I appreciated a space in which I could get lots done. But, thanks to Erica and Brian, I enjoyed the added bonus of finding out about many of the fascinating things going on in town and about their own civic and professional involvement. I felt I came as a guest (a very well-treated one) and left as a friend. I'll surely visit them again.

We stayed with Erica and Brian one night the week of Christmas while scoping out Grand Rapids as a possible relocation city. The hosts were such a welcoming and cool couple to spend the evening with! They gave us great recommendations about sights and eats, and the hot tub on the roof was terrific (even in 30 degree rainy weather). The room (a floor really) was nice, super comfortable bed, and private. It really made Grand Rapids all the better! Thanks so much!

Wonderful space with great hosts. I enjoyed my visit to Grand Rapids thoroughly and felt very much at home. Despite being very allergic to cats and most animals, my allergies did not bother me at all while in thier home . I felt welcomed, with a comfortable space to relax in at the end of the day . Parking was also convenient. Located within several minutes of the downtown area . Very convenient if spending lots of time downtown and the river path is close by for a run/walk. Will definitely return:) thank you!
Erica made us feel very welcome. The property is great - lots of amenities and very unique. We enjoyed this space in a former school house! We'll certainly return when we need a place to stay in GR!

Erica and Brian are great hosts! We had been in the car for 13 hours and were pretty exhausted when we arrived. Erica showed us around their amazing place-in which no detail has been spared-and we felt right at home. Communication was easy as was finding their place. Wonderful experience. Great location.

Erica and Brian are the quintessential hosts. They're inviting and gracious with a beautiful, comfortable home. I don't know why anyone would pay more at a hotel when you essentially get your own floor at Erica & Brian's. If I were to come back to GR, I know where I will go.
Made us feel very welcome. Room was ready and inviting with lots of extras (coffee, snacks, etc.) has a very nice private sitting area with own TV.

Such great hosts and a comfy, private space! You have your own space on the 3rd floor with bedroom, private bath, and sitting area with coffee and tea. Easy parking and easy access to downtown. Plus, Erica and Brian seem to know the city well and are happy to offer recommendations for dinner, breakfast, etc. We loved The Westsider, their breakfast suggestion.

The space: pictures really can't convey how very comfortable this is. The enormous arched window outside the loft gives it an airy feeling and the soft decorative lights transformed it into a magical space at night. We loved the artwork throughout - elegant with a touch of whimsy - from the understated disco ball in the loft to the Frieda Kahlo coaster next to the bed. Even the modest library felt comfortable, with shelves filled with some favorite authors - and others whose titles alone were enough to inspire. The bed was great and luxurious and we appreciated more than enough towels and the higher end products in the shower. Everything was spotless.

The hosts: I've saved the best for last. Brian and Erica are the penultimate Airbnb hosts. Warm and genuine, they made sure we were comfortable and lacked for nothing. They are ambassadors of the beautiful building they live in, Airbnb, and the city of Grand Rapids, and enthusiastically shared their knowledge of and affection for all, which was infectious. When they discovered we were planning on having dinner at the restaurant where Brian's son works, they texted ahead to tell them we were coming - and as a result, we were treated like VIPs. We really could not have had a better experience. Visit! The only thing you will regret is having to leave.
Amazing space, super lovely hosts, learned a ton about the area!

I had a thoroughly lovely time staying at Erica and Brian's condo in Grand Rapids. They were both very warm and welcoming and the space itself was unique and comfortable. Erica greeted me with Michigan apples and a nice tour of the facilities and I felt instantly at home. Definitely a good pair to know!
Cool place. Erica was the consummate host. Great location. Our first airbnb experience, and I can't recommend highly enough.

My wife and I came into town (Grand Rapids) for the night so I could participate in the Grand Rapids Marathon the next morning - Brian was our host (his wife Erica was out of town) and was very attentive and even went to the start line of the race with us and took my wife around Grand Rapids to the various marathon check-points and that was very much appreciated.

In a nutshell, Brian was an attentive and knowledgeable host and I recommend anyone who comes to visit Grand Rapids to stay with Brian and Erica as they know the city very well and can also provide a ton of great recommendations as to what to do on top of staying in a beautiful rehabbed loft space.
Thanks Brian!

For our first AirBnB experience, we couldn't be more pleased. Erica was a very gracious and friendly host and made us feel right at home. We enjoyed getting to know her and hearing about the history of the building. A unique and comfortable space centrally located to all the great downtown restaurants and entertainment. Our only regret was that because our stay was so brief we didn't get a chance to chat with Brian more. We look forward to visiting again when we are in town.

Erica and Brian were terrific hosts! Erica was always prompt with providing information and requests. The arrangements were unbelievable, and the pictures cannot do justice to actually being in the space. The neighborhood is beautifully historic, with only a ten minute walk to the heart of downtown. Our weekend was electric and unforgettable, and a good part of that was due to Erica and Brian's space, and their insistence on including us in the celebration of their friend's winning of this year's ArtPrize!
You are wonderful people. Your kindness and openness really made the start of my retirement special.

Great location - less than a mile from downtown. Really cool space - very comfy bed plus loft . Erica - best host ever ! - she had info on great restaurants and art prize venues - so very helpful - highly recommend.

Erica and Brian are just the kind of hosts you hope to get: knowledgeable about the area, super excited about bringing AirBnB to Grand Rapids, and happy to share their trendy space. We loved using their loft as a place to rest after a long day exploring ArtPrize and hope to go back!

We had a wonderful time at Erica and Brian's beautiful condo! They made us feel right at home and gave us a tour of the many amenities in their historic and interesting building (rooftop pool and hot tub, gym, community room with games). (And cheerfully re-explained the directions when that was necessary!) Our loft area was very comfortable and private with a very nice bedroom, bathroom and sitting area--all beautifully decorated with lots of little unique touches. We appreciated the coffee, oranges, granola bars, dishes and refrigerator in the sitting room. The location was convenient--just across the river from downtown. Artprize was really great--even in the pouring rain!
A really great landmark building very close to downtown. Erica was
super helpful in getting me oriented to both the building and the grand
rapids scene. I need to come back in the summer to take advantage of
the spacious roof deck with pool and hot tub. their unit is immaculate
with huge south facing windows. shelves packed with books on the area

and its history. the guest quarters include a sort of mezzanine lounge overlooking the two levels below w TV and fridge, a private bath and a cozy bedroom without exterior windows but well ventilated and quiet. I didn't meet Brian or the kitty but their home radiates creativity and good vibes.
Our host Erica was very welcoming. She provided lots of great information
on the BNB , the neighborhood, public transportation and greater
Grand Rapids. The photo and description of the place were very
accurate. She provided toiletries, snacks, water...a very nice ambiance.
Very warm, friendly people. Generous and helpful. Would stay with them again. Lovely apartment own bathroom, clean, snacks and coffee. Short but pleasant stay. Thanks guys.
Brian and Erica were wonderful hosts.

We arrived Saturday afternoon as newbies to Grand Rapids for the ArtPrize festival. Brian greeted and acquainted us with our fantastic accommodations! He also gave us some background and history of the loft- as it was formerly an old high school that was converted into very interesting and unique condominiums!
Brian also so kindly gave us a ride to the hub at ArtPrize so we could meet up with our family members that afternoon!

After a busy day taking in all the amazing art and enjoying the city -we returned to the loft to settle in for the evening and enjoy some R&R. The sitting area was great for watching TV and enjoying a beverage! The bed was comfy and cozy...The towels were nice and fluffy :) Great decor and architecture. Along with all the amenities everything was immaculate!

Sunday morning we had a great time chatting with Erica and Brian as they showed us around the rooftop and pool area. We learned that they are very involved in the Grand Rapids community--they are both very cordial and outgoing! Two of the most genuine and nicest people you will ever meet!
Thanks for being so warm and welcoming and making our stay so memorable!
We highly recommend them to anybody passing through Grand Rapids!
